primary_claim: Studying ODEFormer (an 86M-parameter transformer that infers symbolic ODEs from numerical trajectories) via probing, attention/logit lens, and SAEs, we find preliminary evidence that the encoder computes something resembling a numerical derivative (an attention head tracks high-derivative regions, and linear probes can predict the time-point of maximum derivative), but find no evidence that the model performs the hypothesized R^2-based comparison against candidate functions or infers eigenvalues for 2D linear systems.

effect.metric: linear probe accuracy for derivative time-point, R^2 score, and eigenvalues from encoder/decoder activations
effect.value: probes successfully predicted the time-point of maximum derivative but not its value; R^2-score probes performed poorly overall (best layer index 7, Spearman coefficient 0.75); eigenvalue-prediction probes performed worse than coefficient-prediction probes, evidence against the eigenvalue hypothesis

stated_future_work: pinpoint the exact derivative-calculation mechanism, e.g. simple finite difference vs. a higher-order differential scheme
check whether the same derivative-calculation pattern appears in the time-series transformer
interpret other SAE-found features that distinguish different equation types
explore whether activation patterns in mathematically trained transformers resemble those in LLMs (e.g. Llama) performing time-series prediction
limitations_stated: preliminary results are not conclusive enough to eliminate alternative explanations, and only the logistic equation was tested so far for the derivative hypothesis
probes could not predict the value of the maximum derivative, possibly due to insufficient training data or a more complex internal representation (e.g. mantissa/exponent)

the R^2-score probing experiment only considered 1D ODEs from the same distribution as ODEFormer's pretraining data, on which it usually achieves R^2 close to 1, limiting the probe's ability to learn lower R^2 values
SAE features on ODEFormer did not yield clearly interpretable patterns corresponding to obvious mathematical concepts, and t-SNE visualizations showed no clear structure
the eigenvalue hypothesis for how ODEFormer solves 2D linear systems is unsupported by the data
quote: we observed a pattern similar to numerical computation of the input data derivative
